description: This file defines CRC32 checksum calculation functions and external references, specifically a lookup table and inline functions for computing CRC32 checksums over data buffers.

methods.name: uint32_t crc32(uint32_t val,const void * ss,int len)
methods.description: Calculates a 32-bit CRC over a buffer using a lookup table, given an initial value and buffer data.

methods.name: unsigned int crc32buf(char * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Calculates a CRC32 checksum for a buffer starting with a predefined initial value.

ctags.name: crc32buf
ctags.pattern: /^static inline unsigned int crc32buf(char *buf, size_t len)$/
